hypothesis: Minimum-token processor transitions may explain cost differences among batches with identical sampling-copy requirements; the cardinality of short output lists exposes these transitions.

pcvs.name: batch_changed
pcvs.rationale: Captures the fixed metadata reconstruction path.

pcvs.expression: int(self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed) * (int(not self.all_greedy) + int(not self.no_top_p) + int(not self.no_top_k) + 3 * int(not self.no_penalties) + int(not self.no_allowed_token_ids))
pcvs.name: metadata_tensor_copies

pcvs.expression: int(len([ids for ids in self.req_output_token_ids if ids is not None and len(ids) <= 1]) > 0)
pcvs.name: minimum_token_transition
pcvs.rationale: Identifies newly admitted requests or requests reaching the workload's one-token minimum, potentially triggering logits-processor mask updates.

pcvs.expression: len(self.batch_update_builder.added) + len(self.batch_update_builder.removed) + len(self.batch_update_builder.moved) + (self.num_reqs if self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed and (not self.no_penalties) else 0)
pcvs.name: request_update_work
pcvs.rationale: Captures request-level batch updates and prompt-padding iterations.
